title: FAA AD 2026-09-01
currency: Historical captured public document, not an authoritative current AD/SB/AMOC corpus.
incorporated_material: Boeing Requirements Bulletins are referenced but their complete effectivity tables, procedures and timing are not available here.

review_notes.interpretation: 787-8/-9/-10 model scope remains conditional on the referenced 2022 Requirements Bulletin. The retained reference-date exception uses June 29, 2023; do not substitute the new AD date throughout.
New actions depend on the 2025 Issue 002 Requirements Bulletin. The specified Issue 001 date reference is replaced by June 3, 2026; other timing details require the incorporated document.
Completion of the new actions terminates retained paragraph (g) only for the airplanes identified in the new Requirements Bulletin. A new revision is not blanket closeout evidence.
The old-part installation prohibition is conditional on prior replacement at the same inspection location. A 787-10 cannot be dismissed just because the new-inspection discussion concerns 787-8/-9.
Retained credit has explicit scope and dates. The public discussion rejects automatic credit for the earlier Issue 001 new-action bulletin; no generic old-revision credit is assumed.
AMOC approval belongs to the specified FAA authority or authorized ODA under the AD provisions. This software has no approval or maintenance-release function.
